question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The word "exercise" fits the context as the sentence discusses activities that improve cardiovascular health and boost the immune system.**
 
• The word **"laughter"** does not fit the context as it is not specifically related to cardiovascular health or the immune system.
 
• The word **"work"** is too general and does not directly relate to the idea of physical activities aimed at health improvement.
 
• The word** "entertainment"** does not fit the context as it generally refers to activities for amusement rather than health benefits.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
